- TAM assigned hours and on-call coverage model (rotations, regional overlap)
- Escalation ladder and specific SLA response/ack windows for Sev1/Sev2/Sev3

Subject: Support & TAM coverage details for Redwood RFP - FederalBank (pack delivered)

Hi Samantha — attached is the packet we discussed. Summary below; full attachments are the TAM notification matrix (PDF) and the Q4 on-call roster (CSV). If you need redacted copies we can provide a secure transfer.

Executive summary (high level):
- Coverage model: Redwood provides 24/7 coverage for Severity 1 incidents across all supported deployments (Hosted, Dedicated, Private). TAMs are assigned as the customer-facing technical lead during onboarding and provide primary support during business hours (M–F 08:00–18:00 local). Outside business hours TAM responsibilities are handed to the on-call engineering rotation; TAM remains a secondary contact for coordination and post-incident follow-up.

- Escalation ladder and objective windows:
  * Sev1 (service down / critical security incident): initial ack within 15 minutes via Support portal/phone/SMS; primary TAM engages within 1 hour; engineering pager escalation if not contained within 4 hours.
  * Sev2 (partial outage / degraded functionality): ack within 1 business hour; TAM engagement within 4 hours; engineering support engaged depending on diagnostics (SLA defined case-by-case).
  * Sev3 (minor issue / informational): ack within 1 business day; TAM engagement during next business window.

- Incident comms cadence & templates:
  * Notification at T+0 (initial inbound ack); T+1h (status update for Sev1); hourly until containment, then T+6h and T+24h summary; final RCA within 5 business days for Sev1.
  * Channels: primary: Support portal (ticket + email); escalation aliases: tam-federalbank@redwood.ai; pager/SMS for engineering as listed in roster.

- Evidence/runbook examples: included excerpt shows our incident triage checklist, KV cache flush guidance, and rollback checklist; full runbook available under secure review. Audit logs (control plane) retained for 13 months by default; extended retention available on request and covered under Private deployments.

- Contacts & redaction options: Attached roster contains role-based aliases for procurement distribution (primary/secondary). We can provide personal cells under NDA if required.

Attachments: Redwood_TAM_Notification_Matrix_v1.pdf (matrix with severity->notifiers->cadence), roster_oncall_redwood_2026Q4.csv (roles + primary/secondary + alias)

Next steps: please confirm if a redacted PDF is acceptable or whether you need live secure access to artifacts. If FederalBank wants premium 24/7 TAM coverage (TAM in primary on-call loop instead of engineering), we can include a pricing addendum in the contract.

Best regards,
Irene Choi
